Famous Amos cookie brand gets its own streaming series 'Famously You'

The streaming series 'Famously You' is based on the Famous Amos cookie brand and will premiere exclusively on The Roku Channel on July 24. Gabrielle Union is an executive producer, and the series is created and hosted by Rev Shawn Amos, son of founder Wally Amos. The show features guests with unique passions and a lineup including Robert Ri'chard and Rachel Dratch.

Mark July 24 and send 'Famously You' to someone who grew up with Famous Amos cookies.
